description: Fork of exp329_cfc. Adds partition_sets to out_proj so its input anchor pairs are restricted to within-head pairs (no cross-head anchor pairs). out_proj input is H*d_v = 4*16 = 64 = 4 heads x 16 dims; partitions = [[0..15],[16..31],[32..47],[48..63]]. Canonical pool shrinks from C(64,2)=2016 to 4*C(16,2)=480. Other modules unchanged (q/k/v still unrestricted).
